votes.bill_title: Stop Insider Trading Act
votes.plain_language: This bill generally bars members of Congress and their spouses and dependent children from buying stocks, and it requires public notice before they sell. A Yea passes it in the House. A Nay votes against passage.

votes.question: On Motion to Recommit — Stop Insider Trading Act (H R 7008)
votes.bill_title: Stop Insider Trading Act
votes.plain_language: The Stop Insider Trading Act would bar members of Congress and their spouses and dependent children from buying stocks and would require public notice before a sale. A Yea would have made that swap; a Nay kept the original bill.

posts.text: Our veterans deserve access to the high-quality care, benefits, and support they have earned through their service to our nation..! I was proud to support yesterday’s House passage of the bipartisan “Take Care of America’s Veterans Act,” a comprehensive package of more than 60 https://t.co/H2fs878FiU

Happy Veterans Day to the men and women in #VA02 and across the country who have served our great nation in uniform! Today and every day, we thank you and your families for the sacrifices you have made in defense of the country we all love….! 🇺🇸 https://t.co/MgxQmTKyIE

I’m deeply saddened to hear of the passing of former Congressman Bill Whitehurst. For nearly 20 years, Congressman Whitehurst proudly represented Hampton Roads in the House of Representatives, advocating for our military community, our Commonwealth, and our country. My thoughts https://t.co/AsX87c7JfK
Happy Birthday to @USMC…! For 251 years, the men and women of our Marine Corps have served our nation with courage and unwavering commitment. Semper Fi! https://t.co/bRreLZZqvQ

Happy National Nurse Practitioners Week to our healthcare heroes across the nation and here in #VA02! As a geriatric nurse practitioner, I am proud to represent all nurse practitioners in Congress and to be your voice in Washington. Thank you to our amazing NPs for providing exceptional healthcare to those in need….!
🚨Virginia🚨TODAY is Election Day…! Polls are open until 7pm. To find your polling location, visit https://t.co/LzTnXLfa5E! https://t.co/Ar8pjRSH88

Community safety and law and order begin with a secure southern border. For 17 straight months, there have been zero releases at the southern border, a clear sign that strong border enforcement and effective policies are making a difference. We must continue supporting the men and women on the front lines who work every day to protect our communities…!
Happy Halloween #VA02…! 🎃 Hope you all get to enjoy more treats than tricks today! And be sure to watch out for our tiny trick-or-treaters tonight…! #HappyHalloween https://t.co/VraEdDRbE3

Yesterday I was joined by Congressman Brett Guthrie for a tour of STIHL’s manufacturing facility in Virginia Beach…! We had the opportunity to meet with company leadership and see firsthand the important work being done to support good paying jobs and local domestic manufacturing in Hampton Roads. Thank you to @RepGuthrie for coming to #VA02 and to @STIHLUSA for your continued investment in Virginia!

This morning I celebrated the opening of a new McDonald’s franchise right here in Virginia Beach..! This restaurant will bring 50 new jobs to the area and provide delicious hamburgers and fries for everyone! The franchise also presented checks to @OceanLakesHS Athletics and @operationsmile in support of their work in our community. Thank you to Zak Hayes and the @McDonalds team for the invitation and for investing in Virginia Beach…!

Yesterday I joined Navy leaders, maritime industry stakeholders, and policymakers at the Ironclad Maritime Summit to discuss the future of American shipbuilding! As a Navy veteran, I know how critical our shipyards and continued investment in shipbuilding are to maintaining a mission-ready fleet, strengthening national security, and supporting our regional economy. Thank you to @HRVA_Alliance and @navyleaguehr for bringing us together for this important conversation…!

I'm excited to see CMS announce a new $275 million initiative to recruit and retain over 4,000 nurses in nursing homes across the country, particularly in rural and underserved communities…! As a geriatric nurse practitioner, I know firsthand how important our nursing workforce is to providing quality care and this investment will help strengthen our workforce and expand career opportunities for years to come!

Read more👉https://t.co/4aUOpZSvS9

We said a special thank you to the @asymca staff at the recent Military Families Fall Fest we attended! I am personally grateful for ALL they do to support our servicemembers and their families…! From providing essential resources to creating opportunities for military families https://t.co/omg8he6MM1

We said a special thank you to the @asymca staff at the recent Military Families Fall Fest we attended! I am personally grateful for ALL they do to support our servicemembers and their families…! From providing essential resources to creating opportunities for military families to connect, your work makes a real difference in our Hampton Roads community. I’m grateful for your continued dedication to those who serve our nation and the families who stand beside them!

Our public shipyards are critical to keeping our fleet mission-ready..! I’m proud to join @RepGoodlander in introducing the “Shipyard Modernization Sustainment Act” to strengthen oversight of the Navy’s shipyard modernization efforts, keep projects on schedule, and ensure taxpayer dollars are spent responsibly. As a Navy veteran, I’ll always fight to ensure our shipyards have the resources they need to support our national defense…!

Read my press release👉https://t.co/bY2eCWcpJY

I joined the Armed Services YMCA of Hampton Roads for their Military Family Festival and Resource Fair in Virginia Beach today…! Our military families make tremendous sacrifices in service to our nation, and events like this are a great way to bring our community together while connecting families with valuable resources and support. Thank you to the @asymca and everyone who helped make this special day possible for our military families…!

This morning I joined the @alzassociation and our Hampton Roads community at Chesapeake City Park for the “Walk to End Alzheimer’s.” This important event brings friends and families together to raise awareness, support those living with Alzheimer’s and their loved ones, and advance the fight to find a cure. Thank you to everyone who came out to walk, volunteer, and support this meaningful cause…! (& it was so amazing to see my former colleagues from EVMS who work everyday to take care of those impacted by Alzheimer’s…!)

I joined Acting Secretary of the Navy Hung Cao and Hunt Military Communities to celebrate a major milestone in expanding privatized unaccompanied housing for the Navy…! As a Navy veteran and the representative of #VA02, home to so many servicemembers and their families, I know how important quality housing is to military readiness and quality of life. This project will help deliver modernized housing for our Sailors across Hampton Roads, ensuring they have the living conditions they deserve. Thank you to @HuntMilitary, @SECNAV, and everyone involved for your commitment to improving the quality of life for those who serve our great nation…! ⚓️🇺🇸

The Working Families Tax Cut that I proudly voted for delivered relief for small businesses across #VA02. By locking in the 20% small business deduction, @HouseGOP is supporting the men and women that create jobs and drive our local economies…! https://t.co/Pi0pahkiBo

Families visiting our federal beaches deserve to know that proper lifeguard coverage is in place to keep their loved ones safe…! Earlier this year, my bipartisan Safe Beaches, Safe Swimmers Act passed the House, and it allows the Department of the Interior to partner with local https://t.co/4CLmTO9vQC

🚨#VA02 Students🚨 My office is accepting applications for the 2026 Congressional App Challenge…! If you’re a middle school or high school student in #VA02 interested in participating in this awesome tech opportunity, you have until October 26th to complete your submission! #HouseOfCode

For more informationinformation👉https://t.co/MucqzUAqnQ

The Working Families Tax Cut delivered meaningful relief for hardworking men and women across #VA02, including tax relief on tips and overtime! I’ll always fight to ensure you keep more of your hard-earned money…! https://t.co/lIuAHuDPIv

🚨ATTN #VA02 Students🚨 My office is accepting applications for Congressional nominations to attend our nation’s U.S. Service Academies..! The deadline is FRIDAY, OCTOBER 23rd. Each application is reviewed through an independent, merit-based process, with interviews and recommendations conducted by a panel of representatives from each branch of the U.S. Armed Forces. If you’re interested in applying, visit https://t.co/SPAmF4Ens5 or call my office at (757) 364-7650 if you have any questions..!🇺🇸

Thanks to the Working Families Tax Cut Act, investment in domestic manufacturing facilities is projected to increase by up to $590 billion, creating new jobs and opportunities for our nation’s hardworking men and women…! I’m proud to stand with @HouseGOP in supporting pro-growth policies that strengthen our economy and keep jobs right here at home!

I was honored to join Health & Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. for a visit to Tidewater Community College’s Regional Health Professions Center and a discussion with local healthcare providers and administrators about improving access to care in Virginia’s Second District. As a geriatric nurse practitioner, I know a strong healthcare workforce is essential to quality care. Thank you to @SecKennedy, @TCC, and our healthcare partners for helping prepare the next generation to serve Hampton Roads…!

I was proud to join the U.S. Department of Agriculture and Farm Service Agency Administrator Bill Beam on the Eastern Shore today to tour Cherrystone Aqua-Farms and hear from our local producers! Virginia is the nation's leading producer of Eastern oysters and hard clams, and it was great to see firsthand how one of Virginia’s famous delicacies is grown and harvested. Thank you to Cherrystone Aqua-Farms, our @USDA partners, Administrator Beam, and our local producers for taking the time to meet with us about the important work you do! 🦪 

Read my press release👉https://t.co/EUOi7ba5OD

I was proud to participate in the ribbon cutting for the new Warriors Taphouse location at @FlyORF this morning! Founded by three individuals with strong ties to our military community, Warriors Taphouse is dedicated to honoring our servicemembers, veterans, and their families while giving back to organizations that support them. Congratulations to the entire @warriorstap team on this exciting expansion, and thank you for your continued commitment to our military community here in Hampton Roads…!

For so many of us in Hampton Roads, including myself, the Navy is our family. Everyday I wake up and focus on how I can work to make life better for our sailors and their families. There is much to be done but today we take a moment and celebrate the best fighting force in the world!! Happy 251st Birthday Navy…!! ⚓️ Here’s to many more decades of service to our great nation!! 🇺🇸

Our nation’s air traffic controllers play a critical role in keeping America’s skies safe. That’s why I was proud to cosponsor the “Air Traffic Controller Workforce Development Act” to expand training opportunities, improve recruitment and retention, and strengthen mental health resources for our air traffic controllers. This bill will address staffing shortages and ensure our aviation workforce has the resources they need to keep travelers moving safely and efficiently…!

I visited the Children’s Center in Suffolk to learn more about the incredible work they do to support children and families across Coastal Virginia! From early childhood education to pediatric therapy and family support services, their dedicated staff helps ensure children have the resources they need to learn, grow, and thrive. Thank you to the Children’s Center team for the warm welcome and for all you do to make a difference in our community…!

Last night I joined the Coastal Virginia Association of REALTORS for their Legislative Reception! Our local real estate professionals play an important role in helping families achieve the American Dream of homeownership. I appreciated the opportunity to discuss the importance of expanding housing opportunities and keeping Coastal Virginia a great place to live, work, and raise a family. Thank you to @HRRAREALTORS for having me…!

Yesterday I joined Isle of Wight County Schools for their 10th annual “Crunch Heard ‘Round the Commonwealth” to celebrate Virginia agriculture and local farm-to-school initiatives. I also enjoyed touring the award-winning Agricultural Land Lab and seeing firsthand how students are learning about agriculture and where their food comes from. Programs like these help connect students with Virginia’s farming community and highlight the important role agriculture plays in our local economy. This was a great way to celebrate National Farm to School Month and thank you to @iwcschools for having me…! 🍎

I was proud to join my @HouseGOP colleagues in voting for the Working Families Tax Cut, which delivered over $189 million for healthcare in Virginia through the Rural Health Transformation Program! These investments will help expand access to quality care in our rural communities, strengthen our healthcare workforce, and improve telehealth and maternal care services…!!

As a longtime fan of Hubs Peanuts, it was great to visit Hubbard Peanut Company in Sedley and see firsthand how one of the finest Virginia products is made! Hubs plays an important role in Virginia’s agriculture industry and our nation’s peanut production. I appreciated the opportunity to hear more about their work and the role they play in supporting our local economy and American agriculture. Thank you to the @hubspeanuts  team for inviting me and showing me around your facility…!

Today marks the third anniversary of Hamas’ brutal attack against Israel—including the murder of unarmed men, women, and children. As we remember those murdered that day and mourn the lives lost in the years since, we continue to pray for their families and loved ones. We must never forget Hamas’ acts of terror, and as Americans, we must stand unequivocally with Israel. 🇺🇸🇮🇱

I visited Smithfield Foods’ headquarters and production facility in Smithfield, VA to learn more about their operations and the important role they play in Southeastern Virginia! For more than 90 years, Smithfield has supported American farmers, created jobs, and helped feed families across the country. Thank you to the @SmithfieldFoods team for having me and for your continued investment in our community…!!

This morning I visited Lyon Shipyard to learn more about the important work they’re doing to support our Navy and commercial shipping industry. Since 1928, Lyon has been a key part of Hampton Roads’ maritime industry, supporting our fleet and strengthening our local economy. It was great to meet with leadership and their employees and to see their operations firsthand. Thank you to the Lyon Shipyard team for having me and for all you do to support our Navy, our maritime industry, and Hampton Roads..!

Earlier this year, my @HouseGOP colleagues and I passed the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act to cut unnecessary red tape, expand access to local lending resources, and help increase America’s housing supply. By expanding housing opportunities and eliminating barriers to homeownership, we’re helping more families achieve the American Dream…!

Thank you again to @epa_fotouhi for joining us in #VA02 to celebrate over $90 million to support the Chesapeake Bay! These investments will support commonsense projects that protect our waterways and strengthen our coastal communities…! https://t.co/lTWyNDKxcA

Recently, we hit an important milestone..! Since I’ve been in Congress, my office has helped save or return over $20.5 MILLION to constituents across #VA02…!! If you need help navigating the federal government, please visit https://t.co/t20G4TH50G. Our team is always ready to help!

Community safety and law and order begin with a secure southern border. For 16 straight months, there have been zero releases at the southern border, a clear sign that strong border enforcement and effective policies are making a difference. We must continue supporting the men and women on the front lines who work every day to protect our communities…!

Happy Manufacturing Day! Here in Southeastern Virginia, manufacturing supports good-paying jobs, strengthens our economy, and plays a critical role in our national security. That’s why I was proud to support efforts like my bipartisan Veterans Energy Transition Act to connect our servicemembers and military families with career opportunities in energy and advanced manufacturing. Thank you to the hardworking men and women who keep American manufacturing moving forward…!

Today I joined EPA Deputy Administrator @epa_fotouhi and @JRAvirginia in Smithfield to announce $39 million in grants for Chesapeake Bay restoration projects! These investments will support commonsense, on-the-ground projects that protect our waterways, strengthen our coastal communities, and preserve the Chesapeake Bay for generations to come…! Exciting work is ahead for Coastal Virginia!! 

Read my press release👉 https://t.co/LEZ0fl9eff

I was honored to join local officials and ViDARR leadership to celebrate the ribbon-cutting of their new Virginia Beach facility! Their building is dedicated to the legacy of Rear Admiral Thomas R. Richards, who honorably served our country for more than 30 years. This $2.69 million investment will provide new tools for our warfighters, create more local jobs, and strengthen our Hampton Roads economy. Thank you to ViDARR for investing in the future for our military…! ⚓️

Big news for Windsor and the Commonwealth of Virginia! LG Electronics is investing $64 million to open a new HVAC assembly facility at the Shirley T. Holland Intermodal Park in Windsor. This investment is a strong vote of confidence in Southeastern Virginia’s skilled workforce and will help strengthen American manufacturing while creating new opportunities for hardworking families. I’m proud to support economic development in our community and look forward to welcoming LG’s new facility to Windsor…!

Read my press release👉 https://t.co/O8oYhXIwqL

It was a privilege to attend yesterday’s Isle of Wight “State of the County” to hear more about the county’s progress and priorities for the future. From supporting our small businesses to creating new opportunities for families, I’m committed to helping our communities grow and thrive across our district. Thank you to the Isle of Wight Chamber of Commerce for bringing us together for this important conversation…!

Yesterday I visited Fairlead’s facility and Radian Forge in Portsmouth to meet with their teams and see their manufacturing operations firsthand…! Hampton Roads plays a vital role in supporting our Navy, and companies like these are strengthening our defense supply chains, expanding American shipbuilding capacity, and creating skilled jobs right here in Coastal Virginia. Thank you to both teams at Fairlead and @radianforge  for showing me the work you do for our region and our national security…!

roll_calls.question: On Motion to Recommit — Take Care of America’s Veterans Act (H R 9237)
roll_calls.plain_language: H.R. 9237 (Take Care of America’s Veterans Act) addresses veterans’ benefits, health care, counseling, Department of Veterans Affairs personnel, VA infrastructure, and the Veterans Community Care Program. A motion to recommit is the minority's last formal chance to send a bill back to committee before the passage vote. A Yea supports sending it back; a Nay keeps it on the floor for the passage vote.

roll_calls.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Housing for the 21st Century Act (H R 6644)
roll_calls.plain_language: This bill establishes and modifies various federal housing programs. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

roll_calls.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Concur in Senate Adt to House Adt to Senate Adt — Housing for the 21st Century Act (H R 6644)
roll_calls.plain_language: The 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act establishes and modifies various federal housing programs. This vote, under suspension of the rules, was on accepting the Senate's latest changes to the bill after the chambers traded versions, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea accepts the Senate's version; a Nay opposes it.

financial_disclosures.caption: Official House financial disclosure filings from the Clerk of the House. A filing lists assets, income, liabilities, and trades the member reported; it is not proof of a conflict or of wrongdoing. Dollar ranges and asset names are in the PDF. This page links to the Clerk's copies and does not score anyone.

funding.heading: Disclosed campaign receipts
funding.detail: Federal cards show the principal campaign committee and OpenFEC totals for one two-year cycle, plus itemized Schedule A contributors. House uses 2026. Senate uses the cycle of the next election (2026, 2028, or 2030). This is not career fundraising and does not include Schedule E outside spending. Governors do not get a federal contribution list.

town_halls.note: There is no national town-hall dataset. Dates are not estimated.

disclosure_note: Disclosed contributions only; donors behind groups that do not report their own donors are not in this feed.
vote_scope: This is not a full career record. The cache is the latest 40 House rolls (2026, rolls 275-314) and 40 Senate votes (119th Congress, session 2, votes 217-256).
